composition.serve_who: The sheet details the Mast Block hydraulic manifold (Danfoss PVG 32) and its 6 individual functional slices. The specific slice labels clearly establish that this manifold serves the lifting keel system (up/down and locks) and the four mast winches (forward port, forward stbd, aft port, aft stbd).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The first two manifold slices are explicitly labelled 'LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN' (EV-6.1) and 'LIFTING KEEL LOCKS' (EV-6.2).

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN
functions.what_it_does: Directs hydraulic fluid to the main actuator to raise or lower the lifting keel.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the open neutral position; P rail is blocked, A and B work lines bleed to the T rail via small orifices, and the LS line drains to the T rail.

Spool shifts to connect the P rail to port A; pressured fluid flows upwards through the double pilot-operated (PO) check valve to the actuator. Return fluid from the actuator provides pilot pressure to open the port B PO check valve and returns via port B to the T rail. Port A maximum pressure is limited to 60 bar by an inline port relief valve.

Spool shifts to connect the P rail to port B; pressured fluid flows upwards through the double PO check valve to the actuator. Return fluid from the actuator provides pilot pressure to open the port A PO check valve and returns via port A to the T rail. Port B maximum pressure is limited to 220 bar by an inline port relief valve.

functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVEU - 0-10 V (proportional electric); Rating: spool 40 lt/min

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL LOCKS
functions.what_it_does: Controls hydraulic fluid to engage or disengage the lifting keel locking mechanisms.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the closed neutral position; P, A, and B ports are blocked; the load-sense (LS) signal is vented to tank.

Spool shifts to connect the P rail to port A; pressured fluid flows to the actuator lock. Return fluid from the actuator enters port B and flows to the T rail. Port A pressure is limited to 100 bar by an inline relief valve.

Spool shifts to connect the P rail to port B; pressured fluid flows to the actuator unlock. Return fluid from the actuator enters port A and flows to the T rail. Port B pressure is limited to 100 bar by an inline relief valve.

key_components: Main directional spool valve (3-position, closed center)
functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVEO - ON/OFF; Rating: spool 5 lt/min

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.3 is explicitly labelled 'MAST WINCH AFT PORT'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH AFT PORT
functions.what_it_does: Drives the portside aft mast winch motor via hydraulic flow.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the open neutral position; P rail is blocked, A and B ports are open and connected to the T rail.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail through the upstream compensator to work port A. Return flow from the winch enters port B and is directed to the T rail. Anti-cavitation check valves draw makeup fluid from T if pressure drops below tank line pressure. Maximum pressure on port A is limited to 250 bar by the shock relief valve.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail through the upstream compensator to work port B. Return flow from the winch enters port A and is directed to the T rail. Anti-cavitation check valves draw makeup fluid from T if pressure drops below tank line pressure. Maximum pressure on port B is limited to 225 bar by the shock relief valve.

key_components: Main directional control spool (3-position, open neutral)
functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVED - ON/OFF; Rating: spool 65 lt/min

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.4 is explicitly labelled 'MAST WINCH FWD PORT'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH FWD PORT
functions.what_it_does: Drives the portside forward mast winch motor via hydraulic flow.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the open neutral position; P rail is blocked, A and B ports are open and connected to the T rail.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail to work port A. Return flow from the winch enters port B and is directed to the T rail. Port A overpressure dumps to the T rail at 250 bar via shock relief valve.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail to work port B. Return flow from the winch enters port A and is directed to the T rail. Port B overpressure dumps to the T rail at 225 bar via shock relief valve.

functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVED - ON/OFF; Rating: spool 65 lt/min

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.5 is explicitly labelled 'MAST WINCH AFT STBD'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH AFT STBD
functions.what_it_does: Drives the starboard aft mast winch motor via hydraulic flow.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the open neutral position; P rail is blocked, A and B ports are open and connected to the T rail.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail through the compensator to work port A. Return flow from the winch enters port B and is directed to the T rail. Shock relief valve opens to vent fluid to the T rail if port A exceeds 250 bar.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail through the compensator to work port B. Return flow from the winch enters port A and is directed to the T rail. Shock relief valve opens to vent fluid to the T rail if port B exceeds 225 bar.

functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVED - ON/OFF; Rating: spool 65 lt/min

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.6 is explicitly labelled 'MAST WINCH FWD STBD'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH FWD STBD
functions.what_it_does: Drives the starboard forward mast winch motor via hydraulic flow.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool is in the open neutral position; P rail and LS line are connected to the T rail.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail to work port A. Return flow from the winch enters port B and is directed to the T rail. A port pressure is limited by a relief valve set to 230 bar dumping to the T rail.

Spool shifts to direct flow from the P rail to work port B. Return flow from the winch enters port A and is directed to the T rail. B port pressure is limited by a relief valve set to 225 bar dumping to the T rail.

functions.dry_data: Actuation: PVED - ON/OFF; Rating: spool 65 lt/min

facts: Inlet section at the far left provides main pressure supply (P), return (T), load sense (LS) line connections, a pressure relief circuit, a standalone auxiliary valve, and a gauge port (M).
The block unifies six active manifold slices sharing common P (Pressure), T (Tank), and LS_A/LS_B (Load Sense) galleries.
Contains proportional control sections for lifting keel and mast winches.

discarded_as_clutter: Part numbers extracted from cartridges (e.g., 157B7122, 11166838, 11130982, 157B6203, ENE8E63) mapped out in favor of functional roles.
Revisions table from 2022 to 2026 (rows 0 through 10) in the bottom right corner, as it provides administrative history rather than operational component specs.
uncertainties: Exact internal connections of the uppermost spool envelope on EV-6.5 (appears to be a float position tying A and B to tank, but lines are too dense/small to confirm 100%).
